answer_1.quote: Given a query q and a large corpus of text C (e.g. Wikipedia), AQA consists of predicting an answer a and a passage p ∈ C to attribute the predicted answer.

answer_2.quote: Indeed, given a query, answer and passage triplet (q, a, p), attribution evaluation measures the portion of answers a attributed to p. In contrast, Exact-Match requires a gold answer ã to compare to the predicted answer a.

answer_3.quote: We also experiment with PaLM 2 a new state-of-the-art multilingual large language model (LLM) in few-shot and scarce data (250 examples) settings.

answer_4.quote: For each (query, answer, passage) triplet, we ask three raters to answer "Is the answer attributed to the passage?".
answer_4.guideline: Is the answer attributed to the passage?
